name: Frontiers of the Roman Empire – The Lower German Limes
description: This 400-kilometre stretch of the Roman Empire's northwest edge follows the Rhine from the hills of western Germany to the North Sea coast in the Netherlands. Its 102 sites include fortresses, forts, harbours, a canal, an aqueduct and an amphitheatre, almost all of them buried underground. Waterlogged soil has kept even wooden structures and other organic remains in remarkable condition.
